title: task-focused-snippets-anti-patterns-and-migration-notes-for-ui-primitives
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a compact, task-oriented section on the docs site that surfaces copy-paste snippets, clear do/don't anti-pattern examples, and migration notes for tokens, buttons, tables, and charts. The goal is to reduce onboarding friction for engineers and designers by providing ready-to-use patterns for common tasks (e.g., building a responsive table row, creating accessible primary/ghost button variants, migrating legacy token names to the new semantic palette, and embedding charts with consistent spacing). This is not a full rewrite of component API docs — it complements the API reference with pragmatic recipes, edge-case guidance, and a short migration mapping table.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Task pages for Tokens, Buttons, Tables, Charts exist under /docs/recipes with consistent header and quick-copy snippets
A2: Each task page includes at least one small anti-pattern example and a short explanation of why it fails (accessibility, performance, or cross-breakpoint issues)
A3: Migration section includes a token mapping table (legacy -> semantic) and a recommended replacement pattern for 6 common button variants
A4: Snippets are linted and validated: Storybook + eslint-plugin-redwood-snippets passes or there is a documented exception
A5: Figma components and tokens links are present and verified; designers have sign-off in comments
A6: Docs include a short section on console telemetry hooks to track snippet usage (optional acceptance for analytics)
tasks: Inventory existing recipe-like pages and snippets across the docs site and internal hack notebooks
Draft token migration mapping CSV and embed a trimmed table in the Tokens task page
Author 4 button recipes: Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Danger with a11y note and keyboard examples
Author 3 table recipes: responsively collapsing columns, virtualized body pattern, row-action affordances
Create 2 chart embedding recipes: consistent paddings/legend placement and low-data states
Add anti-pattern callouts with short rationale and suggested fix for each recipe
Add lint/CI checks for snippet formatting and run against sample repo
Get design and accessibility review (Figma + a11y checklist) and update pages
Publish to staging and run a short internal QA pass with engineers
design_notes: Use compact header with 'What you need' + 'Quick copy' + 'Why this works' triage on each recipe
Prefer code sandbox snippets (<= 8 lines) that are copyable; link to full examples in Storybook for deeper context
Token migration mapping should show: legacy token, semantic token, CSS var example, migration script snippet
Visual examples use 1rem baseline spacing; charts should demonstrate 3 density rules for mobile/tablet/desktop
Anti-pattern visuals should use red overlay labels and a short inline 'why' tooltip
decisions: D1: Keep component API reference separate; recipes will link to API docs rather than duplicate props lists
D2: Migration mapping will favor semantic tokens; an automated codemod will be proposed in a follow-up ticket
D3: Snippets will be framework-agnostic pseudo-code + a React/TSX variant in a collapsible block
D4: Accessibility notes will be mandatory for button and table recipes (keyboard semantics, focus ring, color contrast)
